$comment: Editorial metadata for the Game Board. Build-history metrics come from data/telemetry/games.json; deployed URLs from data/deploy.json. This file is the single source of truth for game identity, copy and visual accent.

site.title: Game Board
site.tagline: Three browser games. Zero hand-written code. Every prompt, token and dead end on display.
site.author: Khanh Tran

games.title: First Hearth
games.subtitle: A living world
games.oneLiner: One wanderer, an unnamed valley, and a lit hearth. Everything else is history.
games.description: A deterministic, simulation-first civilization builder that runs in a browser tab. Procedurally generated continents, named citizens who age and die, 54 resources, 93 buildings, 95 discoveries and sixteen daily tick systems that keep the world moving whether you look or not.
highlights: 112x112 seeded worldgen with rivers, biomes, deposits and 3-5 AI neighbours
Citizens with names, families, skills, morale and private thoughts
84 unit tests, 62 browser checks, 60 fps at 4x speed with 140+ population

media.heroAlt: A walled town at year four: fields, workshops and temples on an isometric map

gallery.alt: The Codex panel: discoveries across six branches
The opening moves checklist and a creed decision over a young settlement

games.title: Blade & Mount
games.subtitle: Tournament of the Realm
games.oneLiner: Sixteen fighters, four rounds, and the whole yard watching.
games.description: A browser 3D melee game in the spirit of Mount & Blade: Warband's arena and tournament modes. Four directional strikes, stamina, guard-breaking kicks, hit zones and a betting purse - with fighters, armour, arena, crowd and audio all generated at runtime.
highlights: Four-directional attack and guard system with reach, speed and armour penetration
Head, torso and leg hit zones; speed bonus from stepping into a strike
112 unit tests; runtime-generated arena, crowd, props and retargeted KayKit animations

media.heroAlt: The tournament board with four houses advancing to the lists

gallery.alt: The main menu behind a gate at dusk
In-bout HUD with opponents beaten and remaining
The armoury: choose your arms before a bout

games.title: Alien Shooter
games.subtitle: Neon Arena
games.oneLiner: You are the last survivor on colony XR-7. The nests have opened.
games.description: A top-down survival arena that runs from a static folder with no build step and no dependencies. Endless waves, five alien types with distinct behaviour, sixteen upgrades, a four-attack boss every five waves, and touch controls for phones.
highlights: Five enemy archetypes: crawlers, skitters, spitters, brutes and wave bosses
16 upgrades across stats and rare drops, plus XP magnet and dash i-frames
Zero dependencies, zero build: plain HTML, CSS and Canvas 2D

media.heroAlt: Combat in the neon arena with alien waves converging

gallery.alt: Title screen: NEON ARENA // SURVIVAL PROTOCOL
Choosing one of three upgrades on level up
Signal lost: score, best, wave, kills, level and run time
